$comment: The things we scan for. One entry per case study / portfolio item. Keep the slug stable, inventory.json keys off it. `queries` are the literal search strings; write them the way a journalist would name the thing, not the way we name it internally, and include the partner brand, the venue and the year, because that is what actually appears in a headline. `aliases` catch the names the press uses that we do not. LESSON, learned the hard way: two entries came back empty on the first sweep because the queries were written in our vocabulary rather than the vocabulary of the people who write about the work. Black Coffee was filed by us under Club Space and covered by everyone else as Hialeah Park racetrack; the L-Acoustics install was filed by us as a sound-system implementation and covered by the trades as L-Acoustics DJ / spatial audio / the S3QU3NC3 stage. Write queries the way a journalist would.
